profile.description: Active Green River Chamber festival, but the organizer has stated its insurance does not allow inflatables at the event.

notes.subject: Insurance restriction prohibits inflatables
notes.body: The Green River Chamber replied Aug. 3, 2026 that its insurance will not allow inflatables at River Festival. Current Chamber information confirms River Festival remains active; 2026 ran Aug. 14-15 at Expedition Island/Evers Park. This is a structural restriction, not a routine yearly decline. Do not repeatedly pursue unless the insurance/venue policy changes.
